exceptions.reason: The patched Parcel reporter requires Parcel 2.16 while Plasmo 0.90.5 pins Parcel 2.9; forcing it makes the build invalid.
exceptions.mitigation: Release and CI only run the one-shot Plasmo build and never expose its development server. Track a compatible Plasmo upgrade.

exceptions.reason: The advisory has no patched release and affects generated browser bundles only when attacker-controlled import metadata is built.
exceptions.mitigation: Only reviewed repository source enters the release build; no remote or user-authored modules are compiled by the packaged app.

exceptions.reason: Svelte is a dormant Plasmo transformer dependency; Cortex is React-only and performs no Svelte server-side rendering.
exceptions.mitigation: No .svelte source exists in the extension and the release artifact contains no Svelte runtime. Track a compatible Plasmo upgrade.

exceptions.reason: The advisory has no patched release. The flaw is cross-user disclosure from a shared HTTP cache; here the package sits under Plasmo's got client on a single build machine and serves no other user.
exceptions.mitigation: Build-time only; the extension bundle does not contain it and the extension source has no remote URL imports for the resolver to fetch. Track a patched release or a Plasmo upgrade that drops got.

exceptions.reason: The advisory has no patched release. Stack exhaustion needs attacker-controlled, deeply nested glob patterns; braces is reached only through build and test tooling (Plasmo's Parcel watcher, fast-glob and chokidar, and Sass under Vite and Vitest), which expand patterns from repository configuration.
exceptions.mitigation: Build and test tooling only, never bundled into the extension; the worst case is a failed build or test run. Track a patched braces or micromatch release.
